sloka: नेदानीम् गुह योग्योऽयम् वसो मे सजने वने ।अवश्यम् ह्याश्रमे वासह् कर्तव्यस्तद्गतो विधिः ॥२-५२-६६॥
transliteration: nedānīm guha yogyo'yam vaso me sajane vane ।avaśyam hyāśrame vāsah kartavyastadgato vidhiḥ ॥2-52-66॥

translations.english: Guha this forest where people live is not suitable for my stay. It is necessary that I live in a hermitage. So please do the needful.
